notes.title: Steam Deck Verified (Hauntii Newsletter 2)
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Deck Verification[/h2]
It finally happened - Hauntii is verified for Steam Deck! It's always been optimized to play well on Steam Deck, but there were a few minor issues preventing it from being verified until now. 

[h2]New Build[/h2]
While preparing a new build for Steam Deck, we also added a number of minor fixes and tweaks. These are mostly audio improvements and a few bug fixes. [b]Version 5.4.16[/b]

[h2]Independent Games Festival[/h2]
We were so happy to see that Hauntii won the Excellence in Visual Art award at IGF this year! Thank you judges that is awesome. We've added the badge to to the store page : )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/5ceb01947912a1487236bcec1b9ab568b9997b6a.png[/img]

[h2]Gamescom Latam[/h2]
And finally, we have a booth currently at Gamescom Latam in Brazil! If you saw us there leave a comment hehe.
We're grateful to have received four award nominations from Brazil Independent Games Festival!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/1fc3a7b6355118cc7e017922b30afefd3df66a9c.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
Next up in the works for Hauntii are some improvements for mouse & keyboard input. I'm aware there are some hauntables that have a frustrating experience with this control scheme [spoiler](I'm lookin at you, sandwhales)[/spoiler]

Thanks for reading, until next time!
-MOONLOOP

notes.title: Hauntober
notes.content:
Spooky season is here!
We're pleased to finally share with you what we've been working on these past few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/11b996bdf7e77a57c5766dcad370164bb8590f2d.png[/img]

This update has:
[list]
[*] A new 'stage map' that shows an overhead view of your current stage
[*] Ability to teleport between discovered checkpoints
[*] An brand new Autumn-themed stage
[*] New hauntable creature
[/list]

Additionally we've done some minor bug fixes and audio tweaks.

Here's a little preview of what's new:
[previewyoutube=Lpgz-aBWuks;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy Hauntober!

notes.title: Version 5.2.14 - Window Mode, Star Hints, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/f626b141566f4da471405debc5569fe2c93c4fd4.png[/img]

[h2]All Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add 'window mode' toggle to play in resizable window
[*]Add setting to disable the camera warping fish-eye effect (under accessibility settings)
[*]Added shop, star pedestal, and various icons to the map
[*]Added star hint text to the map (for stars you haven't collected yet)
[*]Stars restore health
[*]Improved in-game cursor
[*]Balance Eternian turrets
[*]Balance fireworks gun
[*]Added skip button to intro cutscene
[*]Now you can press any button to skip the logos in main menu
[*]Fix various minor graphical issues
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]some funky UI behavior when in window mode and window is stretched to non 16:9 ratio
[*]Camera warp setting is missing some language localizations
[/list]

notes.title: Hauntii Update 5.2.7
notes.content:
[h2]Revisions[/h2]
[list]
[*] show collected/total tokens per stage on map
[*] add an option in the crystal menu for unequipping your hat
[*] add missing hats
[*] fix various guidance and map issues
[*] tune bells to be easier to ring, especially on Steam Deck
[*] fix various character animation issues
[*] fix camera and balance on various boss battles
[*] fix some achievement issues
[*] fix star in Crashed Sandship stage that was unachievable after a certain point in the story
[*] make sure stars in the shop show on the map
[/list]

Here's a preview of the new Token counter Sporeo added to your map! Now you can see exactly how many are remaining in each stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587835/04603bd902bcb9afb59574032cd79dbbe22ba6fc.png[/img]

[h2]Version 5.2.2[/h2]

[*] tune bells to be easier to ring, especially on Steam Deck
[*] fix various character animation issues
[*] fix camera and balance on various boss battles

[h3]Previewing in Beta[/h3]
With most updates, we will keep them in the open beta branch for a day or two before setting it live. If you'd like to get an early preview (and help us identify issues!), you can use the following steps:
[olist]
[*] right click on Hauntii in your library 
[*] click properties
[*] select Betas
[*] in the Beta Participation dropdown, choose open_beta
[*] then close that and allow the game to update
[/olist]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Now Integrated
notes.content:
Yep you heard right, Steam Cloud is now implemented for Hauntii! You can now seamlessly move between your different PCs and Steam Deck. 

[i]One thing to note: we don't support save-on-suspend, so be sure that you don't have Hauntii running on two or more systems at the same time in order to prevent conflicts. [/i]

[h3]In the works:[/h3]
In other news, there's a few great updates in the works and coming to you soon. We're currently testing the next build, but it will have the following updates. 
[list]
[*]add an option in the crystal menu for unequipping your hat
[*]add missing hats
[*]fix various guidance and map issues
[*]tune bells to be easier to ring, especially on Steam Deck
[*]fix various character animation issues
[*]fix camera and balance on various boss battles
[/list]

Thank you for playing Hauntii! See you soon.
-Leo

notes.title: Have Some Hearts
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for your feedback and discussion! We're happy to be able to bring these improvements to you:
[list]
[*] Fully restore hearts when respawning
[*] Fix various race balance and hit detection
[*] Fix un-grabbable stars from certain shops
[*] Fix a few localization errors
[*] Efficiency, memory management improvements
[/list]

Thank you for joining us in Eternity!
